question: The radius of a solid lead sphere is 2 cm. 2541 such spheres are melted and recast into a cube of edge x cm. The value of x is (take π = (22)/(7)):
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total volume remains constant: **Volume of Cube** = **Number of Spheres** × **Volume of one Sphere**.

x³ = 2541 × (4/3) × (22/7) × 2³

x³ = (2541 ÷ 21) × 4 × 22 × 8 = 121 × 4 × 22 × 8

x³ = 11² × 2² × (2 × 11) × 2³ = 11³ × 2⁶

x = 11 × 2² = 11 × 4 = 44 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 44 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Radius** of lead sphere (r) = 2 cm

Total number of **spheres** (n) = 2541

**Edge** of the recast cube = x cm

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a **sphere** = (4/3) × π × r³

Volume of a **cube** = s³ (where s is the edge/side)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5a6512f8f0695549f1dce96b75b2033979b34732d0534173e7d7697c0620a960.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total volume of lead = 2541 × (4/3) × (22/7) × 2³

⇒ Volume of Cube = x³

⇒ x³ = 2541 × (4/3) × (22/7) × 8

⇒ x³ = (2541 ÷ 21) × 4 × 22 × 8

⇒ x³ = 121 × 4 × 22 × 8

⇒ x³ = (11 × 11) × (2 × 2) × (2 × 11) × (2 × 2 × 2)

⇒ x³ = (11 × 11 × 11) × (2 × 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 × 2)

⇒ x³ = 11³ × (2²)³

⇒ x = 11 × 2²

⇒ x = 11 × 4 = 44 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 44 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of a Sphere

The amount of space occupied by a 3D sphere is given by V = (4/3) × π × r³, where r is the radius.

Volume of a Cube

The volume of a cube with edge length 'a' is calculated as V = a³.

Melting and Recasting Property

When one or more solid objects are melted and recast into a different shape, the **total volume** of the material remains constant, assuming no wastage.

Surface Area of Sphere

The total surface area of a sphere is 4 × π × r².</p
